$comment: Hand-maintained facts about the AGWP v1 HTTP API that docs/protocol/openapi.json does not carry. Both SDK generators (sdk/typescript/scripts/generate.mjs and sdk/python/scripts/generate.py) read this file; their tests fail when it disagrees with the OpenAPI document. 'retry' classes: read = GET, or a POST that only reads; natural = repeating the call has the same effect as making it once; keyed = the server records the outcome under the Idempotency-Key header (documented in docs/protocol/agwp-v1.md and verified by the retry tests for exactly these seven operations; stream.create and credentials.mint ignore the key by design); unsafe = a repeat may apply twice, so the SDK never retries it on its own (pass an explicit override per call).

alwaysPresent.$comment: Message-typed fields that the protocol declares optional (so the OpenAPI document says '| null') but that ag-server 0.1.0 always fills in. The SDKs type them as present; a live test per field fails if the server ever answers null.

bodies.$comment: Body kinds come from the OpenAPI media types (application/json, application/octet-stream, text/event-stream). This is the one place where the document disagrees with the server: it lists application/octet-stream for the 200 response of objects.put, which answers JSON.
